notes.title: アップデートのお知らせ
notes.content:
・『遺品』に登場する家のステージを追加。
・新ルール「ゴリラ集め」（ゴリラを8匹集めて和室に戻ってくる）の追加。
・新ステージの０秒クリアの報酬スキン「天使」の追加。

notes.title: Update Announcement:
notes.content:
・各ステージを「０秒＆水による回復なし」の条件でクリアすると全部で３種類の「ばななスキン」が入手可能に。
→「設定」の「スキン」から変更可能。
・マルチプレイのステージにある「シンクの水」が「汚水」に変更。
→汚水に入ると秒数が進みます。

Dear players,

We're excited to introduce the latest game update with some exciting changes. Here's what's new:

    Rewards for 0-Second Clears: Successfully complete each stage under the conditions of "0 seconds & no water recovery" to unlock three unique "Banana Skins." You can switch between these skins in the "Settings" menu under "Skins."

    Sink Water Transformation in Multiplayer: In multiplayer stages, the water in the sink has been transformed into "Dirty Water." Entering the dirty water will cause the timer to advance.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy these additions to enhance your gaming experience. Update your game now to explore these exciting changes!

Best regards,
[Your Game Name] Team
